title: 第17章 误会第18章 一挑二误会加深
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “陈初阳，你给我滚出来。”
“欺负我妹妹，你还算是个男人吗？”
“有本事和我商红尘打一架，你这个软弱的男人，你……”
谩骂声响起，陈初阳听着有些刺耳。
他朝着山下看了一眼，流水迷雾阵外面站着商红尘，身后是商红雪和一个小胖子，小胖子不用想就知道是谁了，商家的小老弟，也是他的哎呀小舅子。
都来了，一家人都来了，陈初阳再看对面的商应年，你们一家子是真的合拍，一起来龙蛇山找我的麻烦，他好不容易安抚下了眼前的商应年，再来一个难缠的商红尘。
答应了一些事情，陈初阳才得到了解释的事情，刚刚解释完毕，商应年有些尴尬看着陈初阳，很显然，是他误会了，事情不是他所想那样子。
然后，就有了现在的大眼看小眼的画面。
“那个……小女不懂事，让你见笑了。”
陈初阳摆摆手：“没事，习惯了，你们商家都是一群暴躁的人。”
基因的问题，父亲如此，女儿也是如此，就连儿子也是。
都找上门来，不给人解释的机会，看商红雪跟着一起来，就知道这件事情，商红尘肯定误会自己了，直接打上门来，和眼前的哎呀泰山大人一样，不问原因，打了再说，管你三七二十一。
“咳咳咳，也不是暴躁，主要是这种事情谁也无法淡定啊，我这个作为父亲的，总不能看着女儿被你欺负吧？”
“我家红雪可是我的掌中宝，谁也不能欺负，忽然间红雪红着眼回家，还呕吐了，你让我怎能不往那个方向去想，我……不希望红雪被欺负。”
这是作为父亲的最基本的，他无法治愈宝贝女儿的病情，可他不想女儿被欺负。
平平安安健康成长就行，这个要求很简单。
商应年没想到，事情竟然是这样，这个陈初阳竟然是熬煮药液给女儿，然后，造就了这一系列的误会。
很显然，大女儿商红尘也误会了。
“谁让你们不提前说一声，我也不至于想太多。”
深夜，哭着的女儿呕吐回家，换做是谁，都会乱想。
陈初阳压压手，表示自己明白。
他也没想到会弄得这么晚，超出了他的预计，主要是商红雪那个丫头睡得太沉了，好久没有睡过去，那些药液可以让她安心沉睡，什么都不用担心，可能是很久没有如此沉睡过，她很享受那一刻的睡眠状态。
“不过，陈初阳，你小子可要忍着，不要乱来，不要冲动。”
商应年还是要警告一下。
孤男寡女，还是年轻人，很容易就会擦枪走火。
自己女儿不怕，就怕陈初阳这个血气方刚的少年郎。
陈初阳摸摸鼻子道：“咳咳咳，不会，不会。”
红雪还没长大，要什么没什么，过几年，或许……
“最好如此，你要管好自己。”
“我不希望传出有关红雪的坏消息。”
商应年再一次深深警告陈初阳，宝贝女儿不会乱来，可这个人呢，要警告警告再警告。
实在是不放心啊，回去之后，他一定要叮嘱自己的宝贝女儿，不要靠近陈初阳，尽可能不让他们凑在一起。
陈初阳看向了山脚下，不断叫嚣的商红尘，就是不敢上山。
“你家大女儿怎么办？要不，你去处理？”
商应年抱着手，当做没听到一样，可不会去帮忙。
陈初阳无语，他也只能看戏，谁知道商红尘直接拿着商红雪顶在前面，商红雪身上的阵牌正好可以打开阵法，他们顺着路一直上山，然后，到了陈初阳面前。
是的，这一幕发生得太快了，陈初阳想要阻止也来不及。
商红尘看到了陈初阳的瞬间，直接动手。
“陈初阳，拿命来。”
content_en:
"Chen Chuyang, get out of here."
"You bully my sister, are you still a man?"
"If you have the ability to fight with me, Shang Hongchen, you weak man, you..."
The curses sounded, and Chen Chuyang felt a little harsh.
He glanced down the mountain and saw Shang Hongchen standing outside the flowing water mist formation. Behind him was Shang Hongxue and a little fat man. The little fat man knew who it was without even thinking about it. The merchant's younger brother was also his brother-in-law.
Everyone is here, the whole family is here. Chen Chuyang looked at Shang Yingnian opposite. You and your family are really in tune with each other. You came to Longshen Mountain to trouble me. He finally calmed down Shang Yingnian in front of him, and another difficult Shang Hongchen came.
After agreeing to something, Chen Chuyang got an explanation. Just after the explanation, Shang Yingnian looked at Chen Chuyang with some embarrassment. It was obvious that he had misunderstood and things were not what he thought.
Then, there is the current picture of big eyes looking at small eyes.
"That... little girl is ignorant and makes you laugh."
Chen Chuyang waved his hand: "It's okay, I'm used to it. You merchants are all a group of violent people."
Genetic problems are the same for fathers, daughters, and even sons.
They all came to the door without giving anyone a chance to explain. Seeing that Shang Hongxue followed him, he knew about this matter. Shang Hongchen must have misunderstood him and knocked on the door directly. Just like Mr. Taishan in front of him, he didn't ask the reason and just called you.
"Ahem, it's not that I'm irritable. The main thing is that no one can calm down about this kind of thing. As a father, I can't watch my daughter being bullied by you, right?"
"My Hongxue is my treasure. No one can bully her. Suddenly Hongxue came home with red eyes and vomited. How could you not think in that direction? I... don't want Hongxue to be bullied."
This is the most basic thing for a father. He can't cure his baby daughter's condition, but he doesn't want his daughter to be bullied.
Just grow up safely and healthily. This requirement is very simple.
Shang Yingnian did not expect that things would turn out to be like this. Chen Chuyang would actually cook the liquid for his daughter, which would lead to this series of misunderstandings.
Obviously, the eldest daughter Shang Hongchen also misunderstood.
"If you don't tell me in advance, I won't think too much."
Late at night, when my crying daughter came home and vomited, whoever it was would have been thinking wildly.
Chen Chuyang pressed his hands to show that he understood.
He didn't expect it to be so late. It was beyond his expectation. The main reason was that Shang Hongxue was sleeping too deeply and hadn't fallen asleep for a long time. Those medicinal liquids could make her sleep peacefully without worrying about anything. Maybe it was because she hadn't slept like this in a long time. She enjoyed the sleep state at that moment.
"However, Chen Chuyang, you kid must be patient, don't act recklessly, and don't be impulsive."
Shang Yingnian still needs to give a warning.
When a man is alone and a woman is young, it is easy for him to misfire.
My daughter is not afraid, but I am afraid of Chen Chuyang, a hot-blooded young man.
Chen Chuyang touched his nose and said, "Ahem, cough, cough, no, no."
Hongxue hasn't grown up yet, so it doesn't matter what she wants. In a few years, maybe...
"It's best that you take care of yourself."
"I don't want bad news to get out about Hongxue."
Shang Yingnian once again warned Chen Chuyang deeply that his precious daughter would not mess around, but as for this person, he had to warn and warn again.
He was really worried. After returning, he must tell his precious daughter not to get close to Chen Chuyang and try to prevent them from getting together.
Chen Chuyang looked at the foot of the mountain. Shang Hongchen, who kept shouting, did not dare to go up the mountain.
"What about your eldest daughter? How about you handle it?"
Shang Yingnian folded his hands and acted as if he didn't hear anything and would not help.
Chen Chuyang was speechless. He could only watch the show. Who knew that Shang Hongchen directly held Shang Hongxue in front of him. The formation card on Shang Hongxue's body could just open the formation. They followed the road up the mountain, and then arrived in front of Chen Chuyang.
Yes, this scene happened so fast that it was too late for Chen Chuyang to stop it.
The moment Shang Hongchen saw Chen Chuyang, he took action directly.
"Chen Chuyang, take your life."
